description: The standard outdoor rug size for a patio dining table (24 to 30 inches of rug past the table on every side) or a lounge set (every leg on the rug, 12 to 24 inches past it), and how much patio is left to walk around it (about 36 inches is the advice). Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

kind.description: dining: a table and chairs. lounge: a sofa, sectional or chairs. Default dining.

length.description: Length of the table, or of the area the seating covers, in inches.

patio_length.description: Patio or deck length in feet. Optional: leave out to skip the walkway check.

patio_width.description: Patio or deck width in feet. Optional.

width.description: Width of the table, or of the area the seating covers, in inches.

name: outdoor_rug_size
title: Outdoor rug size calculator
